activitySurface.description: Desktop surface for live activities: `"island"` (default) a Dynamic-Island pill at the top centre of the primary display (around the notch on notched Macs, expands on hover); `"window"` a small always-on-top window in the top-right corner; `"notification"` a system notification (feature `notify`, Linux / Windows).

extensionBundleId.description: Widget extension bundle id (macOS container path). Default: `{app_id}.widgetkit`.

restoreWindowsOnStart.description: Desktop: reopen the widget windows that were open when the app last quit.

transport.description: Host→widget transport driver. Unset: `widgetContainer` on macOS (a Developer ID extension without a provisioning profile cannot open a `group.*` container), `appGroup` elsewhere.

TransportKind.description:
Which Apple host→widget channel to use.

Pick this at build time (you know your signing). Do not rely on runtime fan-out.

oneOf.description: App Group shared container file (`widget_data.json`). Needs a real Team ID. Production-safe default; use `auto` explicitly for ad-hoc probing.
App Group `UserDefaults` suite. Same signing requirements as [`AppGroup`].
Widget extension container file. Works with ad-hoc signing; macOS host must not be sandboxed.
One-shot probe at startup (dev only). Prefer pinning an explicit driver in conf.
